history.summary: GENERIC NAME — identity provisional, uncertainty flagged. 'Kali Mandir' is a generic name with several candidates in and around Kumarghat (Unakoti district); no dedicated history or founding details could be found for any of them. The best-supported referent within Kumarghat town itself is the 'Kumarghat Police Station Kali Mandir' (24.14919, 92.030107), a documented Hindu temple at Kumarghat — coordinates are used for this file. Alternatives: the Bhubaneswari/Bhubaneshwari Kali Temple (Kumarghat area), Saidabari Kalibari (on the Kumarghat-Kailashahar Rd at Fatikroy), the Kali temple at Gournagar (~17 km), and Kali Mandir Temple at Pencharthal (~9.5 km). If the CSV row intended one of these instead, the identity needs correction. No reliable image of the specific shrine was found after genuine searching, so media is empty.
